$description: Resoniq design tokens, version 0.2 (precision-instrument direction). Source of truth for the iOS theme. Dark theme only.

ink.$description: App background, text on accent fills

panel.$description: Instrument panels, tab bar, secondary buttons

panelRaised.$description: Even band in charts, camera placeholder, fills inside a panel

line.$description: Panel borders, grid lines, hairlines, inactive tracks

ivory.$description: Primary text, walls and objects in plans, selected segment

muted.$description: Secondary text, ruler ticks, 'before' traces. Passes 4.5:1 on ink and panel

lime.$description: Primary action, active tab, current step, confirmed improvement, treble end of the frequency scale

teal.$description: Middle of the frequency scale, sound leaving a speaker

indigo.$description: Bass end of the frequency scale. Graphics only, never small text

signal.$description: Something deviates: suspected defect, out-of-band response, noise. Fills and strokes

signalText.$description: Signal colour for text and thin marks on dark

guide.$description: Suggested but not yet tested: target outlines, estimates, next spots

frequency.$description: Colour is pitch. Runs bass to treble: bottom to top on a speaker portrait, left to right on a response curve. Never used as decoration.

evidenceInferred.$description: Concluded from measurements; say what it rests on

evidenceInconclusive.$description: Could not be determined; say why

evidenceEstimate.$description: Rough figure where measurement quality is limited

sans.$description: All UI text. Static faces Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold are bundled (SIL OFL)

mono.$description: Readouts, units, ruler numerals, caps labels (SIL OFL)

safeTop.$description: Content starts below the status bar / Dynamic Island

settle.$description: Speakers and phone glyphs sliding to a position

traceDraw.$description: A result curve draws once, left to right

scan.$description: Sweep line hovering at the current frequency

waiting.$description: Opacity 0.4 to 1 while the app waits on the user or the room

arApproach.$value: impact.soft, repeating; interval shortens with remaining distance
